# IRoundsVaultInputEvents
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/rounds-vault/IRoundsVaultInputEvents.sol)

**Title:**
IRoundsVaultInputEvents

**Author:**
Roberto Cano <robercano>

Events specific to the Input flavor of `RoundsVaultBase`.


## Events
### AssetsDeposited
Emitted by `RoundsVaultInput._operate` when the keeper settles a round and the frozen
underlying-asset liability is deposited into the target vault.


```solidity
event AssetsDeposited(uint256 indexed roundId, address indexed account, uint256 assets, uint256 shares);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`roundId`|`uint256`|The id of the round being settled|
|`account`|`address`|The address that triggered the settlement (the keeper for normal flows)|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The amount of underlying asset that was deposited into the target vault|
|`shares`|`uint256`|The amount of target-vault shares received in return|
